title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
清晨，第一缕阳光洒进木屋，林枫早早的就起床，去往了种植园，主要是看一下昨天种下的种植物。一晚上的功夫。已经有一些种子冒出了嫩芽，甚至已经有几厘米深了。这让林枫忍不住频频点头，“这系统给的金坷垃是真的强呀！”在这个世界上。虽然大多数种植物的成长速度都比前世的成长速度要快。但也没有这么快。顶多就是快个两三倍而已。然后成长环境更好调控。毕竟有着宝可梦这种不讲道理的超凡生物存在。浇了水后。林枫回到了房间里面。藤藤蛇和丑丑鱼都已经醒来，前者正站在窗户面前迎接清晨的朝阳，后者则是跟望夫石一般，撑着呆滞的鱼目看着林枫。林枫拿出昨天剩下的桃桃果能量方块，转入到一个小碗中，对着藤藤蛇喊道，“来，吃早饭了。”“藤藤。”藤藤蛇应了一声，虽然还是有些不大好意思，但已经能接受自己现在的身份了。拿着碗，将它放到桌子上，优雅的拿起一块能量方块吃了起来。林枫又走到丑丑鱼的身边，捏碎一块能量方块，扔了进去。丑丑鱼现在的鳞片还有着坑坑洼洼的地方。如果现在给它进化。虽然美丽鳞片能极大的处理好这些瑕疵，但仍然会影响进化后的美丽度，与其等到那个时候很难处理，还不如在丑丑鱼的时候解决掉。这个问题不大。只要勤换水，好好喂养能量方块，差不多半个月左右就能将这些坑坑洼洼的地方抚平。只是，系统的一句话，就打破了他的这个想法。【恭喜宿主让丑丑鱼的愉悦值从60%提升到75%，奖励金坷垃十袋，神奇糖果一枚，保养能量方块配方。】“嗯....”可能不需要半个月了？林枫有些怪异的看着丑丑鱼。它正欢快的吃着里面的能量方块，完全不知道，因为自己的愉悦提升，又获得了一个适合它的好东西。“看样子，丑小鸭变成白天鹅的日子不远了，”林枫感慨了一声，也不再留意丑丑鱼，而是走到门口，将培育屋的门打开....今天的任务，是去领取自己的培育证书，顺带购置一些培育屋需要的东西，再将藤藤蛇和丑丑鱼挂在自己的培育屋下，东华联盟的律令是。

若是收服了宝可梦，必须在七天之内，将宝可梦的信息登记。并且...初出茅庐的训练家，最多只能收服一只宝可梦！随着你训练家等级的上升，收服的宝可梦数量才能慢慢增多。但培育家就没这个规定了，如果名下挂着培育屋，那能收服的宝可梦就更多了...转头看向已经吃好的两只宝可梦，林枫正打算将它们收进精灵球，背后。一道喊声突然让他停顿住。“枫哥~！”扭头看去，一道白色青春靓丽的少女身影映入眼眶。少女穿着白色短袖和棉质运动裤，扎着短马尾，眼眸清澈如水，还带着几分呆呆的感觉，一张脸蛋有些圆润，透着满满青春气息的胶原蛋白。看样子，应该是来晨跑的。少女瞧见林枫后，眼睛一亮，立马转头向这边跑来。在她的身边，还有一只表情生无可恋的杰尼龟，苦哈哈的喘着气。“嗯？你怎么回来了？是放暑假了吗？”林枫有些惊奇，少女叫秦姝，是秦爷爷的孙女，跟他一样，是在梧桐市的梧桐精灵一中读书，不同的是，秦姝目前就读高二，他已经毕业了。两人一个小镇里面的。在他父母失踪后，秦爷爷也很关照他，时常会送些应季的吃食给林枫。并且嘱咐林枫在学校里面多照顾秦姝。一来二往之下，两人的关系还算不错。“对呀，对呀！昨天放的暑假，我昨晚回来的！”秦姝有些雀跃的道，然后拉着旁边的旁边的杰尼龟，“看，枫哥~这是我刚收服的宝可梦！杰尼龟，快看看！”“杰尼，杰尼....”杰尼龟有气无力的打了声招呼，额头上全是汗水。显然，对于大早就被拉起来晨跑有很大的怨气。“噗....”瞧着这副模样的杰尼龟，林枫也不由得一乐。御三家在这个世界上，虽然不算稀有，但也不是很常见的宝可梦，一般只有中等家庭才能买上一只御三家。
content_en:
In the early morning, the first ray of sunlight shone into the wooden house. Lin Feng got up early and went to the plantation, mainly to take a look at the plants planted yesterday.All in one night.There are already some seeds sprouting out, even a few centimeters deep.This made Lin Feng couldn't help but nod frequently, "The Jin Jialu given by this system is really strong!" In this world.Although most plants grow faster than in their previous lives.But not so fast.At most, it's only two or three times faster.Then the growth environment can be better controlled.After all, there are unreasonable and extraordinary creatures like Pokémon.After watering.Lin Feng returned to the room.Both Vine Snake and Ugly Fish have woken up. The former is standing in front of the window to welcome the morning sun, while the latter is looking at Lin Feng with dull fish eyes like a stone.Lin Feng took out the peach energy cubes left over from yesterday, put them into a small bowl, and shouted to the Vine Snake, "Come on, let's have breakfast." "Teng Teng." The Vine Snake responded. Although he was still a little embarrassed, he was able to accept his current identity.Taking the bowl, he placed it on the table, elegantly picked up an energy cube and ate it.Lin Feng walked to Chou Chou Yu again, crushed an energy cube and threw it in.The scales of the Chou Chou fish still have pits and bumps.If you give it evolution now.Although the beautiful scales can greatly deal with these flaws, they will still affect the beauty after evolution. Instead of waiting until then to deal with them, it is better to solve them when the ugly fish is alive.This is not a big problem.As long as you change the water frequently and feed the energy cubes well, these potholes will be smoothed out in about half a month.However, the system's words broke his idea.[Congratulations to the host for increasing the happiness value of the Chou Chou Fish from 60% to 75%. As a reward, you will receive ten bags of golden garbage, a magic candy, and a maintenance energy cube formula.] "Well..." Maybe it won't take half a month?Lin Feng looked at Ugly Fish strangely.It was happily eating the energy cube inside, completely unaware that because of its increased pleasure, it had obtained another good thing suitable for it."It seems that the day when the ugly duckling turns into a white swan is not far away," Lin Feng sighed, and no longer paid attention to the ugly fish. Instead, he walked to the door and opened the door of the breeding house... Today's task is to get his breeding certificate, buy some things needed for the breeding house, and then hang the vine snake and the ugly fish under his own breeding house. This is the law of the Donghua Alliance.

If you capture a Pokémon, you must register the Pokémon's information within seven days.And...a fledgling trainer can only tame one Pokémon at most!As your trainer level increases, the number of Pokémon you can conquer will gradually increase.But there is no such rule for breeders. If a breeder has a breeding house in his name, there will be more Pokémon that can be conquered... Turning to look at the two Pokémon that had already eaten, Lin Feng was about to put them into the Poké Ball, behind his back.A shout suddenly stopped him."Brother Feng~!" Turning his head to look, a white, youthful and beautiful girl's figure came into his eyes.The girl was wearing white short-sleeves and cotton sweatpants, with a short ponytail. Her eyes were as clear as water, with a bit of a dull look, and her face was somewhat rounded, full of youthful collagen.It looked like he was here for a morning jog.When the girl saw Lin Feng, her eyes lit up and she immediately turned around and ran towards this side.Beside her, there was a Squirtle with a lifeless expression, panting bitterly."Huh? Why are you back? Is it summer vacation?" Lin Feng was a little surprised. The girl's name is Qin Shu, and she is the granddaughter of Grandpa Qin. Like him, she studied at Wutong Elf No. 1 Middle School in Wutong City. The difference is that Qin Shu is currently in the second year of high school and he has already graduated.Two people in a small town.After his parents disappeared, Grandpa Qin also took good care of him and would often send Lin Feng some seasonal food.He also asked Lin Feng to take more care of Qin Shu in school.After going back and forth, the relationship between the two was pretty good."Yes, that's right! I came back last night after the summer vacation yesterday!" Qin Shu said excitedly, and then pulled Squirtle next to her, "Look, Brother Feng~ This is the Pokémon I just tamed! Squirtle, look at it!" "Squirtle, Squirtle..." Squirtle said hello feebly, with sweat all over his forehead.Apparently, there was a lot of resentment about being pulled up early for a morning run."Pfft..." Looking at Squirtle like this, Lin Feng couldn't help but feel happy.Although Gossip is not a rare Pokémon in this world, it is not a very common Pokémon. Generally, only a middle-income family can buy a Gossip.
